responsibility: Computes IRA allocation costs: preferred register classes, per-class and per-hard-register costs, memory costs, and equivalence-related gains for allocnos or pseudos. It maintains the target-dependent cost-class machinery, scans insns to accumulate operand and elimination costs, chooses allocno classes, and later tunes hard-register costs for call-crossing allocnos and alignment-sensitive multi-register assignments. Its outputs guide IRA class selection, coloring, and spill decisions, and some routines are reused by reload/LRA-related code.
